settings.title: Settings
settings.inviteOtherParent: Invite the other parent: they'll see the same calendar, without being able to edit your profile.
settings.holidaysHint: These days override the usual schedule and vacation sharing.
settings.icalHint: Subscribe to this private link from your calendar app. Regenerating the link invalidates the old one.
settings.emailOptIn: Receive an email for swap proposals and their reminders
settings.removeChildBody: Their name is removed from the household for both parents. You can add them again later.
settings.changePasswordHint: Your other devices will be signed out.
settings.exportDataHint: A JSON file with your profile, calendar, expenses and message board.
settings.logoutAllHint: Useful after using a shared phone or computer.
settings.logoutAllBody: All your sessions will be closed, including this one. You'll need to sign in again.
settings.setPasswordHint: You sign in with Google — add a password if you'd like.
settings.setPasswordIntro: Your account uses Google sign-in. A password also lets you sign in with your email.
